<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Smaranava (Clouded Naga)](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3103)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Many view clouded nagas as jealous, malevolent creatures. Only those with the courage to see clearly can recognize these beings for what they truly are: tragic, wounded beings who have been trapped and corrupted by fate. The betrayal and beheading of the naga's mother goddess, [Ravithra](/Deities.aspx?ID=218), cascaded trauma onto all of her creations. Smaranavas have never recovered from this divine wound, and these cursed serpents live wretched half-lives, attempting to fulfill Ravithra's forgotten purpose by tempting and testing mortals they encounter. In this way, they separate the wicked from the righteous, the worthy from the unworthy.

 Smaranavas have dark scales that are rendered dull gray by stuck shed skin, their eyes a milky white due to opaque caps over their eyes. Many ritually scar their necks out of sorrow for their mother Ravithra. Legends claim that the wise and enlightened can free clouded naga from their fates, allowing them to shed their forms and emerge as an awakener naga.

fangs +20 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 2d10+5 piercing plus smaranava venom

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tail +20 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 2d8+5 bludgeoning plus coils of knowledge

**Occult Innate Spells** DC 25
- **Cantrips (4th)**
[Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246), [Telekinetic Hand](/Spells.aspx?ID=1715)
- **3rd**
[Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Lightning Bolt](/Spells.aspx?ID=172), [Mind Reading](/Spells.aspx?ID=194)

**Coils of Knowledge**  ([Force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)) The naga's grip is more spiritual than physical. A creature hit by a smaranava's tail must succeed at a DC 25 Will save or become [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) by the tail until they [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296), the naga releases them with an Interact action, or the naga dies. A captive takes a –4 status penalty to Escape, but can choose to attempt an [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) or [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46) check to Escape instead of the usual options without taking this penalty.

**[Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=57)** <actions string="Single Action" />  2d8+5 bludgeoning, DC 25

**Smaranava Venom**  ([Incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) When a [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) creature succeeds at a saving throw against this poison, it is immediately cured; **Saving Throw** DC 25 Will; **Maximum Duration** 5 minutes; **Stage 1** [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) (1 round); **Stage 2** slowed 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) with no Perception check to wake up (1 minute)

</column>
